# freeimagecompressor.app

> Free online image compressor that runs entirely in the browser.

freeimagecompressor.app is a free, browser-based image compressor that reduces JPG, PNG, WebP, and GIF file sizes with no login, no uploads, and no server processing. All compression happens client-side using the Canvas API.

## Features

- Compress JPG, PNG, WebP, and GIF images
- Adjustable quality slider (1-100%)
- Format conversion (JPG, PNG, WebP)
- Batch compression of up to 20 images
- Optional resizing with aspect ratio preservation
- EXIF metadata stripping for privacy
- Before/after visual comparison
- ZIP download for batch results
- Dark mode support
- Mobile responsive

## Privacy

Images never leave the user's device. Zero server uploads, zero analytics, zero tracking cookies.

## Technology

Single-page static HTML/CSS/JS application. No frameworks, no build step, no backend.
